units.text: INT. SISTERS - CONTINUOUS
Enter TROFIMOV in a worn student uniform and spectacles.
What a marvellous garden! White masses of flowers, the blue sky....
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: Lubov Andreyevna!
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: She looks round at him.
I only want to show myself, and I’ll go away.
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: Kisses her hand warmly.
I was told to wait till the morning, but I didn’t have the patience.
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: LUBOV ANDREYEVNA looks surprised.
Crying.
It’s Peter Trofimov.
units.name: VARYA

units.text: Peter Trofimov, once the tutor of your Grisha.... Have I changed so much?
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: LUBOV ANDREYEVNA embraces him and cries softly.
Confused.
That’s enough, that’s enough, Luba.
units.name: GAEV

units.text: Weeps.
But I told you, Peter, to wait till to-morrow.
units.name: VARYA

units.text: My Grisha... my boy... Grisha... my son.
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: What are we to do, little mother? It’s the will of God.
units.name: VARYA

units.text: Softly, through his tears.
It’s all right, it’s all right.
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: Still weeping.
My boy’s dead; he was drowned. Why? Why, my friend?
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: Softly.
Anya’s asleep in there. I am speaking so loudly, making such a noise.... Well, Peter? What’s made you look so bad? Why have you grown so old?
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: In the train an old woman called me a decayed gentleman.
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: You were quite a boy then, a nice little student, and now your hair is not at all thick and you wear spectacles. Are you really still a student?
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: Goes to the door.
I suppose I shall always be a student.
units.name: TROFIMOV

units.text: Kisses her brother, then VARYA.
Well, let’s go to bed.... And you’ve grown older, Leonid.
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: Follows her.
Yes, we’ve got to go to bed.... Oh, my gout! I’ll stay the night here. If only, Lubov Andreyevna, my dear, you could get me 240 roubles to-morrow morning--
units.name: PISCHIN

units.text: Still the same story.
units.name: GAEV

units.text: Two hundred and forty roubles... to pay the interest on the mortgage.
units.name: PISCHIN

units.text: I haven’t any money, dear man.
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: I’ll give it back... it’s a small sum....
units.name: PISCHIN

units.text: Well, then, Leonid will give it to you.... Let him have it, Leonid.
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: By all means; hold out your hand.
units.name: GAEV

units.text: Why not? He wants it; he’ll give it back.
units.name: LUBOV

units.text: LUBOV ANDREYEVNA, TROFIMOV, PISCHIN, and FIERS go out.
GAEV, VARYA, and YASHA remain.
My sister hasn’t lost the habit of throwing money about.
units.name: GAEV

units.text: To YASHA.
Stand off, do; you smell of poultry.
units.name: GAEV

units.text: Grins.
You are just the same as ever, Leonid Andreyevitch.
units.name: YASHA
